Name: Random Flower Queen
Author: candidus42
Description:
Mod for ContentPatcher that randomly chooses ﻿﻿Leah, Maru, Emily, Haley, Penny or Abigail as the flower queen.

Uses the mod ImagEd to recolor the girls' dresses. This is controlled by config options ColorfulDress and ColorfulSuit. The supported values are the same for both options:
[list]
[*]None - Dresses/suits stay unmodified.
[*]Spouse - Your spouse's dress/suit is colorful.
[*]All - All dresses/suits are colorful.
[/list]If you don't like the dress colors feel free to change the corresponding config options. A color is formatted as [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Web_colors#Hex_triplet]web color hex triplet[/url]. The following example changes Maru's dress to a dark blue:
[code]"DressColorMaru": "#303090"[/code]
Note that the result depends on the flower dress sprite image: In our example we also have to set red and green components to see the details of Maru's dress.
